title.en: An Act Establishing a District Office of the Land Transportation Office in the Municipality of Kalamansig, Province of Sultan Kudarat, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a District Office of the Land Transportation Office in the Municipality of Kalamansig, Province of Sultan Kudarat, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập một Văn phòng Khu vực Land Transportation Office tại Đô thị Kalamansig, Tỉnh Sultan Kudarat, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งสำนักงานเขต Land Transportation Office ในเทศบาล Kalamansig จังหวัด Sultan Kudarat และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk sebuah Kantor Distrik Land Transportation Office di Kotamadya Kalamansig, Provinsi Sultan Kudarat, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan sebuah Pejabat Daerah Land Transportation Office di Perbandaran Kalamansig, Wilayah Sultan Kudarat, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

text.en: There shall be established a district office of the Land Transportation Office (LTO) in the Municipality of Kalamansig, Province of Sultan Kudarat, to be known as "LTO Kalamansig District Office".

The Secretary of the Department of Transportation shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the LTO District Office in the Municipality of Kalamansig, Province of Sultan Kudarat, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect after fifteen (15) days following the completion of its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
